### Data Source Description 
## WEO-IMF 

Our first data set comes from the International Monetary fund (IMF). It is the World Economic Outlook (WEO) from October 2026.
The data are calculated using  hypothesis, notably on oil prices and interest rates. 
Some numerical values change with the evolution of the calculation methods, especially for countries with less qualitative data.
The FMI uses national accounting , balance of payments statistics and public finances statistics which explains the difference of quality between countries input.
The frame of reference may change between countries, possibly leading to different method of calculation. 
Therefore each value shouldn't be considered exact but a order of magnitude.
